date.as_written: nepālabdi himakara samudrāṃka milite dale patraṃ mārgeʼsitimani maheśasya tithau || ... amareśejya divase

notes: The chronogram 'himakara-samudrāṅka' denotes 941 (himakara = 1, samudra = 4, aṅka = 9), though the catalogue record reads NS 940. Maheśatithi is typically the 11th (Ekādaśī / Rudra) or 14th (Caturdaśī / Śiva) tithi; amareśejyadivasa designates Thursday (Bṛhaspativāra).
